identity: Reject wrong title, author, language, work ID, edition ID, acquisition ID, source ID, predecessor package/validation hash, or any inherited Tagalog/Spanish/A Short Method label.
independence: The checker parses source HTML title/front matter and verifies boundary evidence independently; it also compares all candidate text against the exact predecessor that was bound to the complete source inventory and a passing validation receipt. The predecessor mapping and checker share the historical source account; this shared assumption is explicitly disclosed.
limitations: Source fidelity and technical validation do not establish human acceptance.
Project Gutenberg’s stated United States status is not a worldwide rights determination.
Print collation, human acceptance, rights review, and publication remain unresolved.
scope: One complete titled book as identified by the retained English title page; no claim about the author’s complete writings.
source_binding: Verify the retained ZIP SHA, exact 19-member set, each member byte count/SHA, and all 18 source image carriers. Source title, author, language, prefatory note, contents, chapter sequence, and license/end matter are checked against the retained HTML.
text_fidelity: Preserve the complete TEI text subtree byte-for-byte in canonical XML relative to the independently source-bound and passing predecessor candidate. Only the TEI header source description and English language metadata may differ.
